activity_summary: On the third sheet you sent for the glass, had it looked in, and broke it. The three sheets were done. You had not walked once. The prison was still unwritten, and so was the end. The chronicle was still shut.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the glass in three beats and stopped.

entities.name: Richard II
entities.context: Mentioned in Sent for, looked in, broken

facets.activity: Broke the glass on the page
